member.name: T:Fuxion.AspNetCore.IEndpoint
member.summary: Defines the contract for endpoint mapping in ASP.NET Core minimal APIs.

remarks.para: Implement this interface to create endpoint definitions that can be automatically discovered and registered during application startup. Endpoints implementing this interface are registered directly on the without any route group association.

item.description: Automatic discovery: Endpoints are automatically discovered via assembly scanning
Type-safe registration: Strongly-typed endpoint definitions
Modular organization: Encapsulate endpoint logic in dedicated classes

member.name: T:Fuxion.AspNetCore.IEndpoint`1
member.summary: Defines the contract for endpoint mapping within a specific route group in ASP.NET Core minimal APIs.
member.typeparam: The type of the route group that implements . This determines the route prefix and configuration for the endpoint.

remarks.para: Implement this interface to create endpoints that belong to a specific route group. The generic type parameter establishes a compile-time relationship between the endpoint and its parent route group, ensuring type-safe endpoint organization.

item.description: Shared prefixes: All endpoints in a group share a common route prefix
Common middleware: Apply middleware once to all endpoints in the group
Logical organization: Group related endpoints together (e.g., all user operations)
Shared metadata: Apply tags, authorization, or other metadata to all group endpoints

member.name: T:Fuxion.AspNetCore.IRouteGroup
member.summary: Defines the contract for creating route groups in ASP.NET Core minimal APIs.

remarks.para: Implement this interface to define a route group that can contain multiple endpoints. Route groups provide a way to apply common configuration (prefixes, middleware, metadata) to a collection of related endpoints.

item.description: Route prefixes: Define common URL prefixes for all endpoints in the group
Middleware application: Apply middleware to all endpoints in the group
Metadata configuration: Set tags, authorization policies, CORS, etc.
Hierarchical organization: Groups can be nested using

member.name: T:Fuxion.AspNetCore.IRouteGroup`1
member.summary: Defines the contract for creating hierarchical (nested) route groups in ASP.NET Core minimal APIs.
member.typeparam: The type of the parent route group that implements . This establishes a parent-child relationship between route groups.

remarks.para: Implement this interface to create route groups that are nested within other route groups. This enables building complex route hierarchies where groups inherit prefixes and configuration from their parent groups.

item.description: URL composition: Child routes combine parent and child prefixes (e.g., /api/v1/users)
Configuration inheritance: Child groups inherit parent middleware and metadata
Logical organization: Model complex API structures with nested resources
Versioning support: Create version-specific groups within a base API group

member.name: T:Fuxion.AspNetCore.EndpointsExtensions
member.summary: Provides extension methods for automatic endpoint discovery and registration.

remarks.para: This class enables convention-based endpoint registration by scanning assemblies for types that implement or interfaces. It automatically handles route group hierarchies and ensures proper registration order.

item.description: Validates that types don't implement conflicting interfaces
Registers endpoints without groups directly on the builder
Discovers all route groups and builds the hierarchy
Registers route groups in hierarchical order (parent before child)
Registers endpoints within their respective groups
All endpoint and group types must be non-abstract, non-interface classes
All types must have a public parameterless constructor
Types can only implement one of: IEndpoint, IEndpoint<T>, IRouteGroup, IRouteGroup<T>

member.name: M:Fuxion.AspNetCore.EndpointsExtensions.MapEndpointsForAssembly(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder,System.Reflection.Assembly)
member.summary: Discovers and registers all endpoints and route groups from the specified assembly.
member.param: The to register endpoints on.
The assembly to scan for endpoint and route group implementations.
member.exception:
Thrown when:
A type implements more than one endpoint or group interface
A type doesn't have a parameterless constructor

remarks.para: This method performs the following steps:

item.description: Validation: Ensures no type implements conflicting interfaces
Ungrouped endpoints: Registers endpoints that don't belong to any group
Group discovery: Finds all route groups and builds parent-child relationships
Hierarchical registration: Registers groups from root to leaf
Grouped endpoints: Registers endpoints within their respective groups

remarks.para: Performance consideration: This method uses reflection to scan the assembly. It's designed to be called once during application startup.
